answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 49612 Country: India Title: Where to see in tashahhud Question: During Salah, in the position of Tashahhud, where we have to see? Some say "in your lap" while others say "to your pointing finger", which one is correct? Answer ID: 49612 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 137/111/D=02/1435) The scholars of fiqh have stated that one should see in his lap in the state of tashahhud: كما في الشامي: (ولها آداب) نظره إلى موضع سجوده حال قيامه، وإلى ظهر قدميه حال ركوعه، وإلى أرنبة أنفه حال سجوده، وإلى حجره حال قعوده. (1/175مکتبة زکریا) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
